interaction.tfcm.crop_dry: I can't plant %s in the field at (%d, %d, %d) because the soil is too dry. Try irrigating the field or growing something else.
interaction.tfcm.crop_hot: I can't plant %s in the field at (%d, %d, %d) because the weather is too hot. Try growing something else.
